messages:
maria (sales): Kicking off the Cypress POC perf smoke now. Goal: validate sustained 250 qps gen endpoint with p95 < 300ms and reasonable cost. Can eng confirm run config?
raj (eng-sre): On it. Planning a 30m soak + 10m ramp. Test profile: 2k concurrent clients, open-loop, mix 70/30 gen/embed.
alex (eng-platform): Quick note — we'll route traffic to dedicated pool (dedicated-gpu-a), model = vicuna-13b-q4f16 (quantized). Cache enabled.
maria (sales): Thanks. Cypress specifically asked about cold-start tail risk and failover to smaller models — can we document fallback behavior?
raj (eng-sre): Yes. We'll exercise fallback by depleting dedicated pool mid-run to trigger smart routing to hosted-compatible model variant (vicuna-13b-int8). Expect small latency bump.
sophia (solutions): Also need a short blurb for pricing impact if fallback happens (approx +18% token cost) — can finance get a ballpark?
maria (sales): I'll relay. Ops-bot: starting load test now.
ops-bot: run_id=run-1756123456-cypress | start=2025-11-02T15:01:12Z | profile=soak-30m-ramp-10m | qps_target=250
raj (eng-sre): Sending load command (locally):
```
heyload --target https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate \
  --concurrency 2000 --open-loop --ramp 10m --duration 30m --qps 250 \
  --payload-file ./cypress_payload_mix.json
```
raj (eng-sre): Monitoring KPIs: p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, GPU utilization, queue depth, cache hit rate. Will post snapshots every 5m.
alex (eng-platform): Snapshot @ +5m: p50=38ms p95=240ms p99=720ms errors=0. GPU util 82%. Cache hit 62%. Looks healthy.
maria (sales): Nice. Can you also capture token-cost estimate for the 30m run?
raj (eng-sre): Cost estimate (30m at sustained 250qps): ~0.82 GPU-hours -> est infra cost $12. They'll pay usage + reserved commit later.
sophia (solutions): Capturing the fallback test plan now. Tell me when you intentionally reduce capacity.
ops-bot: action=scale-down-simulate | target_pool=dedicated-gpu-a | removal=2/6 instances | timestamp=2025-11-02T15:24:00Z
raj (eng-sre): Induced partial capacity loss at +23m to force routing. Observed graceful routing to vicuna-13b-int8. Latency delta: p95 increased from 240ms -> 380ms, p99 spike to ~1.1s for ~90s window, error rate stayed <0.2%.
alex (eng-platform): After fallback: GPU util on backup pool 65%, cache hit dropped to 41% (model variant mismatch). All requests served.
maria (sales): Good — that matches Cypress's concern about availability. Can we get a short writeup for the prospect with bullet outcomes?
raj (eng-sre): Draft summary: sustained 250 qps pass under normal ops (p95 240ms). During induced capacity loss, automatic fallback maintained availability with temporary tail increase (p95 380ms, p99 ~1.1s). No functional errors. Will attach graphs and raw logs.
sophia (solutions): Add note: expected cost delta when fallback occurs (~+18% per token) and recommended guardrail: set canary traffic threshold + 2x burst capacity to avoid fallback during business-critical windows.
maria (sales): Perfect. Anything blocking for the writeup?
alex (eng-platform): Need permission to share the perf graphs (contains small customer-identifying metadata). If Cypress signs NDA we'll share full graphs; otherwise sanitized metrics are fine.
maria (sales): I'll push NDA. ops-bot: run complete | end=2025-11-02T15:43:09Z | artifacts=/runs/run-1756123456-cypress/{graphs,logs,raw_metrics}.
raj (eng-sre): Post-run final numbers: p50=36ms p95=240ms p99=1.05s overall; tailiness concentrated during induced fallback window. Avg tokens/sec 4100, total tokens ~7.4M.
sophia (solutions): I'll draft the one-pager and include: test config, key graphs, cost delta table, recommended SLA language, and rollback/failover summary.
maria (sales): Thanks team. I'll follow up with Cypress legal on NDA, and schedule a 30min debrief with their infra folks. Closing notes: highlight predictable failover and transparent cost tradeoffs. :thumbsup:
raj (eng-sre): +1. Uploading raw logs to shared run artifacts now.
ops-bot: artifacts uploaded to https://internal-artifacts.redwood/run-1756123456-cypress (access: internal + NDA)
maria (sales): End of thread — will post the one-pager when ready.
